# Lekker Tech

> Lekker Tech is a free Slack community for South African developers and tech workers, wherever they are in the world, to connect, socialise, and support one another. Tagline: "The Slack Where Code Meets Braai".

- Website: https://lekkertech.org.za/
- Join: the "Join the Lekker Squad!" button on the homepage passes a reCAPTCHA check and redirects to the Slack invite. There is no fee.
- Audience: South African tech workers at home and abroad.

## Links

- [Homepage](https://lekkertech.org.za/): what the community is and how to join
- [Website source on GitHub](https://github.com/lekkertech/website): the site is open source
- [X](https://x.com/LekkerTechSlack): official account
- [Bluesky](https://bsky.app/profile/lekkertech.bsky.social): official account
